purpose: Relations and bounded tests for evolving sites, nodes, processes, memories and their observers. Projection over existing source contracts, NOT a second ontology/controller.

research_lenses.purpose: project/source/work identity stable across location, host, provider and brand
research_lenses.inversion: Rename or alias does not mutate the source object

research_lenses.purpose: DNS/public name vs non-DNS namespace and claimed brand
research_lenses.inversion: Suffix does not establish ownership, authority or service

research_lenses.purpose: content source vs compiled page vs CDN-transformed browser response
research_lenses.inversion: Same Git blob may produce different response bytes; compare layers

research_lenses.purpose: device/service cell vs endpoint vs operator vs availability
research_lenses.inversion: Named, reachable, healthy, writable and authorized are independent

research_lenses.purpose: process vs thread vs task vs lease vs operating service
research_lenses.inversion: PID alive is not a completed WorkID; restart is not recovery

research_lenses.purpose: immutable evidence vs index vs semantic interpretation vs cache vs durable custody
research_lenses.inversion: Pointer and semantic summary never replace exact recovery proof
A green aggregate label cannot promote an unknown axis

research_lenses.purpose: source modification vs relation change vs observer projection vs external effect
research_lenses.inversion: A proposal or local commit does not certify receiver change

research_lenses.purpose: single elected writer within effect domain, readers in parallel, fencing and retry
research_lenses.inversion: Duplicate delivery must not duplicate external effect

research_lenses.purpose: consent, purpose, retention, revocation, bystander and delegation
research_lenses.inversion: Visibility and storage do not create sharing or execution rights

research_lenses.purpose: runner source, specific weight file, task outcome, provenance and license separately
research_lenses.inversion: One passing synthetic prompt does not qualify an agent

research_lenses.purpose: literal, hypothetical, metaphorical, cultural and contested relation classes
research_lenses.inversion: Symbolic map must not silently become operational actuation

research_lenses.purpose: valid time vs event time vs observation time vs publication time
research_lenses.inversion: Last update timestamp cannot establish currentness of every layer

research_lenses.purpose: site and node recovery across non-correlated hosting/custody operators
research_lenses.inversion: Two GitHub URLs do not prove independent failure domains

research_lenses.purpose: measured user benefit, maintenance cost and sustainable governance
research_lenses.inversion: More nodes/models/sessions are not automatically a better outcome

standards_donors.use: Transport-neutral source+id event identity and metadata
Separate process-duration spans from point-in-time events
Machine-readable problem details and reason codes for HTTP effect-boundary failures
Single-machine multi-reader/single-writer WAL; do not share writable WAL database across network filesystem

priority_backlog.question: Can one source WorkID change one shadow axis without promoting any other?
priority_backlog.test: Run the 30 checked synthetic adversarial cases; preserve no-effect rail

priority_backlog.question: Can two independent recipients ACK one exact harmless event without duplicate external effect?
priority_backlog.test: Receiver-origin readproof and source+id replay/conflict handling; preserve failure case

priority_backlog.question: Can a public site be served and restored without relying on GitHub?
priority_backlog.test: Exact hash readback from independently controlled host with Github unavailable

priority_backlog.question: Can RickBar show source/site/node/receiver states without one misleading green indicator?
priority_backlog.test: One real user task with visible per-axis evidence, stale timings and Stop

priority_backlog.question: Can storage move from X2 to CoStead without assuming live SQLite WAL over SMB?
priority_backlog.test: Local SQLite WAL + immutable event export + receiver-local import/check, no network-WAL writers

priority_backlog.question: Can a local model produce a source-bound proposal with no mutation authority?
priority_backlog.test: Task-specific fixture and deterministic verifier; effect remains fenced

priority_backlog.question: Can a consent or legal-policy change revoke all pending downstream effects without erasing history?
priority_backlog.test: Revocation test across lease, queue, consumer cursor and recovery

priority_backlog.question: Can one human-facing and one machine-facing site projection share claim provenance despite CDN transformations?
priority_backlog.test: Separate Git source hash, build hash, edge response hash and user acceptance

priority_backlog.question: When would a CRDT be safer than one writer per collision domain?
priority_backlog.test: Compare merge semantics and privacy revocation in a completely synthetic collaborative note; no auto-merge of permissions

priority_backlog.question: Can metaphorical/unknown/negated/inverse relations enrich discovery without becoming mechanistic claims?
priority_backlog.test: Epistemic type-check and adversarial promotion rejection

priority_backlog.question: Does a CivOS or CoStax label buy capability over the existing Windows, SQLite, Ollama and Git adapters?
priority_backlog.test: Compare one end-user task baseline against the alternate; no native OS replacement without evidence

stop_rule: Two consecutive bounded research waves that produce no new externally useful verified capability or meaningful safety finding pause that lane; reopen on changed requirements/security or new credible evidence.
one_elected_next: Existing #317 and #450 owner test one synthetic WorkID readproof across two independent receivers with robust duplicate and revocation tests; do not create a second runtime.
